title: 98% of classical knowledge lost

tellings.quote: you know that um I'm getting this figure from Carl Sean We lost 98% of the knowledge of classical antiquity.

plain: About 98 percent of the knowledge of the ancient Greek and Roman world is said to have been lost, with places like the Library of Alexandria and the city of Corinth tied to that loss. The philosopher Jason Jorjani repeats the figure and says he is "getting this figure from Carl Sagan", the astronomer. If true, it would mean most of what the ancients knew is gone from the record.
